title: Tukey's Interquartile Range (IQR) Fences
description: Non-parametric quartile fencing for identifying outliers without assuming an underlying Gaussian distribution.
conditions: Continuous or discrete ordinal numerical features
Skewed or non-normal distribution where Mean and SD are unreliable
Need for an objective, reproducible cutoff rule
recommended_methods: Inner fences [Q1 - 1.5*IQR, Q3 + 1.5*IQR] for mild outliers
Outer fences [Q1 - 3.0*IQR, Q3 + 3.0*IQR] for extreme anomalies
selection_rules: Use 1.5*IQR for exploratory screening of unusual observations
Use 3.0*IQR (outer fence) when flagging severe anomalies for operational quarantine or automated alerts
For right-skewed data, consider Medcouple adjusted boxplot (Hubert and Vandervieren) to prevent overflagging
limitations: Fixed 1.5 multiplier overflags normal tail observations on skewed distributions
Discards multivariate covariance relationships between features
